chapter: Bass history, future and the scene
title: Audience at Sweet Basil's
summary: She praises the attentive audience at the jazz club.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: What was it like to be — we talked about the gig at Birdland a little bit. Did you get good feedback from the audience?

It was a great audience, and it seemed to be packed in there, and yeah I think they really enjoyed it. And it was good because it was a jazz club, people were there to hear the music. There’s so many places that sometimes you end up playing where there’s a television going on. But this was, the people were there to hear the music and they enjoyed it, and it was great, it was great. And I enjoy having an audience that’s receptive and appreciative.
